lessons_used: home, wait_info changes are helpful, producing 4 significant wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%), though 1 test showed no clear effect.
finish, new_flow changes can be helpful, yielding 2 significant wins (+11.5%, +7.2%), while 3 tests showed no clear effect.
adoption, redesign changes did not work, resulting in 1 guardrail rollback (-10.9%) and 1 test with no clear effect.

candidates.why: The home step has a high mean duration of 2336s. Historical data shows home wait_info changes generated 4 significant wins (+4.2%, +3.1%, +2.7%, +1.7%).
